### `create_attachment`

**Create an Attachment** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/attachments` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Upload an attachment to a task or to a file type Custom Field.

Once a file has been uploaded to a `custom_fields` entity, use [Set Custom Field Value](custom_fields.md#set_custom_field_value) to associate the uploaded file with a task.

To retrieve the ID of a Custom Field, you can use [Get List Custom Fields](custom_fields.md#get_list_custom_fields) or [Get task](tasks.md#get_task).

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `entity_type` | path | `"attachments"` \| `"custom_fields"` | yes | The entity type. Options include `attachments` for tasks or `custom_fields` for a Files Custom Field. |
| `entity_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the task or Custom Field. |
| `file_path` | upload | string | one of file_path / file_base64 | Absolute path of a local file to upload (read by this MCP server on your machine). |
| `file_base64` | upload | string |  | Alternative to file_path: base64-encoded file content. |
| `file_name` | upload | string |  | File name to send (defaults to the basename of file_path). |
| `form_fields` | upload | object |  | Extra multipart form fields. Known fields: filename. |

Uploaded as multipart form field `file`.

### `create_task_attachment`

**Create Task Attachment** · `POST /api/v2/task/{task_id}/attachment` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Upload a file to a task as an attachment. Files stored in the cloud cannot be used in this API request.

***Note:** This request uses multipart/form-data as the content type.*

 ***Tip:** Try our new [V3 Attachments API](#create_attachment), which supports both tasks and File type Custom Fields!*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes |  |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by its custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `file_path` | upload | string | one of file_path / file_base64 | Absolute path of a local file to upload (read by this MCP server on your machine). |
| `file_base64` | upload | string |  | Alternative to file_path: base64-encoded file content. |
| `file_name` | upload | string |  | File name to send (defaults to the basename of file_path). |
| `form_fields` | upload | object |  | Extra multipart form fields. |

Uploaded as multipart form field `attachment`.

### `get_attachments`

**Get Attachments** · `GET /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/attachments` · API v3 · 🟢 read-only

Return a list of attachments for the specified entity, including a task or File type Custom Field.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `entity_type` | path | `"attachments"` \| `"custom_fields"` | yes | The entity type. Options include `attachments` for tasks and `custom_fields` for a File type Custom Field. |
| `entity_id` | path | string | yes | The ID of the task or Custom Field. |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | The cursor to use to fetch the next page of results. |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | The maximum number of results to fetch for this page. (default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
